text.p: Lufthansa Airplus Servicekarten GmbH said it has launched a purchase card for corporate buying of services or goods.
The Deutsche Lufthansa AG credit card subsidiary said the new card could save firms more than 40 percent of process costs by switching to a single card-based ordering and payment system.
A benchmarking study by consultants KPMG for Lufthansa Airplus found that a card system could cut ordering times from up to six days down to a single day, a statement said.
Joint managing director Anton Lill told a news conference: "Through the use of a purchase card process cost savings of more than 40 per cent are possible.
"The market is massive. It is estimated at 30-50 billion marks," he added.
The card company already had 80 purchase card clients who were using the card to order from 20 suppliers, Lill said.
Lufthansa Airplus operates card payments systems for business travel, air cargo, direct marketing and other industries. --Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom. Tel +44 171 542 7706; Fax: 5017
